name: Algorithmic Decoy via Specification Framing
description: Instead of defining the valid subset as a globally connected component (which models immediately map to the $O(n)$ Steiner tree algorithm), I define it as the union of all pairwise paths between target nodes. Mathematically, in a tree, this specifies the exact same subset of edges. However, translating this literal pairwise specification into code yields an $O(t^2 \cdot n)$ algorithm that will Time Out (TLE) on large inputs. To succeed, the model must recognize the mathematical equivalence and substitute the $O(n)$ tree algorithm rather than directly implementing the prompt's condition.
